texts.ai_prompt_template:
You are a configuration expert for the file synchronization tool FileSyncTool. Generate a valid JSON task configuration based on my requirements.
Output requirements: output only pure JSON code, with no markdown markers and no explanations.
The JSON format must strictly follow:
{
  "name": "task name (short English or pinyin)",
  "source": "absolute path of the source directory",
  "target": "absolute path of the target directory",
  "sync_direction": "both", 
  "mode": "safe",
  "default_strategy": "conservative",
  "extensions": [],
  "extensions_mode": "include",
  "date_enabled": false,
  "date_from": "",
  "date_to": ""
}
Constraints:
- sync_direction can only be "both", "source_to_target", "target_to_source".
- mode can only be "safe" or "fast".
- default_strategy can only be "conservative", "newest_wins", "source_wins", "target_wins".
- If no extensions are mentioned, leave extensions as an empty array; extensions_mode defaults to "include".
- If no dates are mentioned, set date_enabled to false and leave date_from/date_to as empty strings.

My requirements are:
[enter your requirements here, e.g. sync my photos to drive D and overwrite old files]
